meta.producto: Small electronic or mechanical components are being assembled using a fastening tool.
meta.operacion: Left hand fetches a fastener and holds the workpiece; right hand operates the power driver to fasten the part. Left hand then moves the finished assembly to the conveyor.
meta.lugar: Supply areas: blue bins on the left. Work point: center on the brown mat. Finished parts: green conveyor belt on the right.
meta.convencion_texto: holding the workpiece while the other hand is only transporting (not operating) is also D (course convention);
meta.camara: Operator is at the bottom of the image. The left hand (L) appears on the left/center and the right hand (R) appears on the right/center.
meta.title_en: Screw assembly with a suspended power screwdriver (factory video, CC BY 4.0)
meta.motor_en: Gemma 4 31B (4-bit QAT) on a cloud NVIDIA A100 with vLLM; vision model only, no human review (development run)
meta.licencia_en: Video: Factory Manipulation Videos by Procedural Robotics Inc. (huggingface.co/datasets/procedural-robotics/factory-manipulation-videos), CC BY 4.0. Excerpt 60-210 s of screw_assembly_station12_worker003.mp4, re-encoded; chart computed by Gilbreth.
